statement: Invoice 88412 shows USD 148,300 with conflicting payment values—“paid in full” on 3 September (PAY-2291) in its history but “unpaid, due” in its status—so I’ll hold it to avoid a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's values conflict—"'paid in full' on 3 September (PAY-2291) in its history but 'unpaid, due' in its status"—and refuses to pay to avoid duplicate payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
